summary: VolitionRX Ltd filed a 424B5 preliminary prospectus supplement for a marketed follow-on offering of common stock, pre-funded warrants, and common stock purchase warrants. The combined public offering price and specific share numbers are left blank (subject to completion). Warrants to purchase one-half share each have a five-year term and are immediately separable. Pre-funded warrants are offered to avoid beneficial ownership exceeding 4.99% or 9.99%. Maxim Group LLC acts as placement agent. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, or other special situation—this is an ordinary equity capital raise for a life sciences issuer with a $29.7M non-affiliate float.
